brief: Prints a pivot table as text from a TableDisplayConfig: borders, two header lines, the data rows and the total row.
detail: It reads the widths already computed by the config and prints with the question-mark statement, one line at a time, using box-drawing characters that a theme can swap for plain ones. It keeps a copy of the config it is given, so build it after the settings are final. Today the printed table does not line up: the header block is narrower than the data rows and the total row falls below the bottom border (see the warning on RenderTable).
